name: fluentmcp
description: Full control of FluentCRM and FluentCart on your WordPress site: contacts, campaigns, orders, products, subscriptions, and more.
long_description: Gives your AI assistant create/read/update/delete control over FluentCRM (email marketing & CRM) and FluentCart (e-commerce) by WPManageNinja — 699 documented REST endpoints, each as its own individualized tool (crm_contacts_list, cart_orders_refund, …), with a built-in tool_map index so the assistant finds the right tool in one call. Safe by default: every destructive tool (deletes, refunds, cancels, mass-sends, resets) is annotated and refuses to run without explicit confirmation. One WordPress Application Password runs everything; run the verify_setup tool after installing to check your connection. Prefer a small tool list? Set the Tool Surface option to "grouped".

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your WordPress site root, e.g. https://example.com (not the /wp-admin URL).

api_username.title: WordPress Username
api_username.description: The WordPress admin user the server acts as (needs FluentCRM/FluentCart permissions).

api_password.title: Application Password
api_password.description: Create under WP Admin → Users → your user → Application Passwords → Add New. One password runs both FluentCRM and FluentCart tools.

tool_mode.title: Tool Surface
tool_mode.description: individual (default): one tool per operation, ~700 small tools plus a tool_map index. grouped: the legacy ~46-tool surface (one tool per area, an action parameter picks the operation) for clients that struggle with large tool lists.

tools.name: tool_map
tools.description: This map — overview, per-area drill-down, keyword search.

tools.name: verify_setup
tools.description: Check credentials, connectivity, and plugin presence per product.
